title: Validation errors show offending DSL line content
description: validate_dsl.py now shows the offending source line under each validation error. _format_validation_report() accepts dsl_path, loads source lines, extracts line numbers from error strings, and appends the source line with an arrow prefix. Also fixes JSON parse failures in _run_java_validator() to return a proper error dict instead of propagating JSONDecodeError.
definition-of-done: 1. Validation errors show offending line content with arrow prefix. 2. Parse errors show offending line. 3. Non-JSON validator output returns helpful error dict. 4. All callers thread dsl_path.
testing-plan: 1. Wrong port name error shows source line. 2. Wrong node type error shows source line. 3. Empty validator output returns helpful error.
